name: v3-beaver-gnaw-anticipation
js: {const c=__critters; c.until(c=>c.beaver.stage==='gnaw: anticipation' && c.FELL[0].bites>5); c.run(0.05); c.cam(c.beaver, -0.45, 0.12, 1.5, 0.3);}

name: v3-beaver-gnaw-hit
js: {const c=__critters; c.until(c=>c.beaver.stage==='gnaw: hit' && c.FELL[0].bites>5); c.run(0.04); c.cam(c.beaver, -0.45, 0.12, 1.5, 0.3);}

name: v3-beaver-drag
js: {const c=__critters; c.until(c=>c.beaver.stage==='drag the branch', 200); c.run(2.2); c.cam(c.beaver, 0.25, 0.3, 2.4, 0.2);}

name: v3-beaver-swim-branch
js: {const c=__critters; c.until(c=>c.beaver.stage==='swim to the dam', 200); c.run(3); c.cam(c.beaver, 0.5, 0.3, 2.2, 0.1);}

name: v3-beaver-tail-slap-raise
js: {const c=__critters; c.beaver.pos.set(-9.5,2.55,0.5); c.go('beaver','slap'); c.until(c=>c.beaver.stage==='tail slap: anticipation'); c.run(0.15); c.cam(c.beaver, 0.15, 0.25, 2.2, 0.15);}

name: v3-beaver-tail-slap-hit
js: {const c=__critters; c.beaver.pos.set(-9.5,2.55,0.5); c.go('beaver','slap'); c.until(c=>c.beaver.stage==='tail slap: hit'); c.run(0.07); c.cam(c.beaver, 0.15, 0.25, 2.2, 0.15);}

name: v3-beaver-shake
js: {const c=__critters; c.beaver.pos.set(-11.5,3,11.5); c.beaver.wet=1; c.go('beaver','shake'); c.until(c=>c.beaver.stage==='shake off' && c.beaver.step.t>0.45); c.cam(c.beaver, 1.2, 0.18, 1.5, 0.15);}

name: v3-otter-splash
js: {const c=__critters; c.until(c=>c.otter.step && c.otter.step.name==='slide' && c.otter.waterAt()>0.5); c.run(0.12); c.W.cam.set([-13.5,2.8,-5.6], 0.7, 0.3, 3.5);}

name: v3-sea-otter-crack-hit
js: {const c=__critters; c.run(1); c.until(c=>c.sea.stage==='crack: hit'); c.run(0.06); c.cam(c.sea, 1.0, 0.45, 1.5, 0.1);}

name: v3-sea-otter-dive
js: {const c=__critters; c.go('sea','dive'); c.until(c=>c.sea.stage==='roll over'); c.run(0.3); c.cam(c.sea, -0.2, 0.3, 1.6, 0.0);}

name: v3-night-beaver-lantern
js: {const c=__critters; c.until(c=>c.beaver.stage==='drag the branch', 200); c.run(4.5); c.cam(c.beaver, 0.6, 0.35, 2.8, 0.2);}

name: v3-beaver-close-side
js: {const c=__critters; c.beaver.pos.set(-12.5,3,13.5); c.go('beaver','sit'); c.run(0.2); c.go('beaver','fell'); c.run(1.2); c.cam(c.beaver, 0.0, 0.12, 1.05, 0.15);}

name: v3-beaver-close-above
js: {const c=__critters; c.beaver.pos.set(-12.5,3,13.5); c.go('beaver','sit'); c.run(0.2); c.go('beaver','fell'); c.run(1.2); c.cam(c.beaver, 0.6, 1.05, 1.15, 0.1);}

name: v3-beaver-gnaw-owner
js: {const c=__critters; c.until(c=>c.beaver.stage==='gnaw: anticipation' && c.FELL[0].bites>5); c.run(0.05); c.cam(c.beaver, -0.45, 0.12, 1.0, 0.3);}

name: v3-beaver-gnaw-back
js: {const c=__critters; c.until(c=>c.beaver.stage==='gnaw: anticipation' && c.FELL[0].bites>5); c.run(0.05); c.cam(c.beaver, 2.6, 0.35, 1.0, 0.3);}

name: v3-dusk-beaver
js: {const c=__critters; c.beaver.pos.set(-12.5,3,13.5); c.go('beaver','sit'); c.run(0.2); c.go('beaver','fell'); c.run(1.2); c.cam(c.beaver, 0.9, 0.2, 1.6, 0.2);}
